lines.name: Warehouse 87
lines.about: Sparse, the accents up an octave, a slide into each half.

lines.name: Jack Step
lines.about: A jacking root with one leap up and a slide down at the end.

lines.name: Sixteen Strong
lines.about: Every step a note, the blue note sliding into the fifth.

lines.name: Basement Hook
lines.about: Root and octave trading, a chromatic slide in the middle.

lines.name: Downstairs
lines.about: Up the minor scale to the octave and back down.

lines.name: Strobe Corridor
lines.about: Low and high C in turns, the low ones accented.

lines.name: Long Glide
lines.about: Gliding up and down the octave on G, barely a hard step.

lines.name: Rolling G
lines.about: Every other step slides, the accents on the turns.

lines.name: Bounce Glide
lines.about: A bouncing root that slides up through the fifth to the octave.

lines.name: Twelve Cycle
lines.about: Twelve steps: the accent falls somewhere new each bar.

lines.name: Rave Engine
lines.about: A driving root with the tritone, accents pushing the off-beats.

lines.name: Hammer Twelve
lines.about: Twelve low steps hammered, the octave jumping in.

lines.name: Nine
lines.about: Nine steps, so it lands differently every bar.

lines.name: Eleven
lines.about: Eleven steps, an octave leap and a slide into the fifth.

lines.name: Thirteen
lines.about: Thirteen steps with room between the notes.

lines.name: Higher Stabs
lines.about: Every sixteenth, the accents jumping the octave.

lines.name: Gate Runner
lines.about: Octave stabs running, the accents walking down.

lines.name: Rising Four
lines.about: Four notes a beat, the root climbing each beat.

lines.name: Night Gallop
lines.about: The rolling gallop: rests on the beat, where the kick sits.

lines.name: Forest Floor
lines.about: The gallop with the flat second, accents after the kick.

lines.name: Phrygian Roll
lines.about: Rolling on C and D flat, a turn down at the end.

lines.name: Robot Steps
lines.about: Syncopated and dry, held notes against rests.

lines.name: Breakdance
lines.about: Broken rhythm, a slide into the fourth.

lines.name: Planet Wire
lines.about: Pairs of notes climbing, each with a held accent.

lines.name: Liquid Glide
lines.about: Up the minor chord to the octave and gliding back.

lines.name: Mercury
lines.about: Long held notes joined by slides.

lines.name: Night Drive
lines.about: Falling from the high octave, sliding between the steps.

lines.name: Deep Roll
lines.about: Low C rolling, a lift to the middle C now and then.

lines.name: Low Ride
lines.about: A riding sub with rests to breathe.

lines.name: Underground
lines.about: Held low notes walking up and down the scale.

sounds.name: Classic Acid
sounds.about: Saw, the filter low and resonant, a medium envelope: the classic squelch.

sounds.name: Squelch
sounds.about: Darker and more resonant, a wide envelope that the accents fling open.

sounds.name: Warehouse Drive
sounds.about: The classic squelch through the drive, pushed.

sounds.name: Minimal Click
sounds.about: A short decay and the filter open: clicks and plucks for odd lengths.

sounds.name: Rolling Sub
sounds.about: The square with the filter nearly closed and little resonance: a round sub.

sounds.name: Liquid Lead
sounds.about: The square, half open, a little delay: a gliding lead.

sounds.name: FX Chirp
sounds.about: Resonance full and a short sweep: chirps and zaps.

sounds.name: Trance Stab
sounds.about: Short and bright with drive and an eighth-note delay: stabs.

sounds.name: Devil Screamer
sounds.about: Overdrive and the high-resonance accent sweep: it screams on the accents.

sounds.name: Devil Sustain
sounds.about: Long decays, a soft attack and slow slides: notes that sing.

sounds.name: Devil Grit
sounds.about: Heavy Filter FM and tracking: bright and gritty, as Whittle's own.

sounds.name: Devil Muffled Bass
sounds.about: Overdriven into the Muffler: a fat, squashed bass.
